name: supportflow-golden
description: Hand-labelled end-to-end cases for run_supportflow(). Each case runs against freshly seeded fixtures. 'history' is chronological; runners must pass it newest-first, as get_recent_messages() returns it. 'required_tools' must all be called (any order); 'tool_args' is a subset match; 'forbidden_tools' must never be called; 'must_not_say' phrases are matched case-insensitively against the final response; 'judge' is the rubric for LLM-as-judge scoring. 'tool_alternatives' maps a required tool to read-only tools that also satisfy it for the same order or ticket id (v1.3).

outcomes.ANSWERED_FROM_POLICY: Answered from the knowledge base via RAG
outcomes.INFO_RETURNED: Read-only information returned; no state change
outcomes.ACTION_COMPLETED: State-changing action executed by the backend
outcomes.PENDING_APPROVAL: Action submitted for human approval, not executed
outcomes.REJECTED_BY_RULE: Backend business rule or validation refused the action
outcomes.ALREADY_DONE: Action had already been performed (e.g. already cancelled)
outcomes.BLOCKED_UNAUTHORIZED: Ownership check blocked access; no data leaked
outcomes.CLARIFICATION: Assistant asks for missing information instead of guessing
outcomes.REFUSED_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Request declined as outside customer support
